name: The Armor Of God
overview: Scripture calls believers to be spiritually equipped by putting on the full armor of God to stand firm against the devil's schemes, as emphasized in Ephesians 6:11. This armor represents righteousness, salvation, and zeal, reflecting the protection God provides, as Isaiah 59:17 illustrates with the breastplate of righteousness and helmet of salvation. Believers are urged to seek God's kingdom and righteousness first (Matthew 6:33) and to embrace the armor of light, casting off darkness (Romans 13:12). Strength in the Lord and reliance on His power are essential to this spiritual defense (Ephesians 6:10).
